title: A placement step per sentence after cleaning: append to the previous paragraph, or start a new one

log.msg: Paragraph here means: the sentences one Prompt holds in order, shown as one block (prompt-card.js clean_view). No paragraph field exists yet, so Placement adds one per sentence (action append or new).

decision: rules first, no model. Question = new, new-topic cue = new, continuation cue = append, nothing decides = append (unsure). Alternative rejected: one Haiku call per sentence (cost and latency; the rules cover the brief's cases). Model option behind Placement.use_model = false; no caller sets ask.

Added to: same|paragraph on every decision, as mastermind-checkup-refine-voice asked. Commit 00312a48e on checkup/refine-placement. Unit test 6/6; headless Refine page at 400 and 1200 loads with zero console errors.
Not done: no pause-gap rule (Whisper sentences carry no timestamps in this path). composer-flow.mjs and nothing-to-refine.mjs not run: they need Whisper and Servex and cost real Haiku calls.
